# search

Search, AIMA style: state-space search (uninformed and informed), local, evolutionary and swarm search, adversarial search, constraint satisfaction, planning and refinement search, each an algorithm that records its frontier and explored set so it can be animated. The planning and evolutionary folders are part of this entry point.

- structure `problem.ts` (file): The search problem contract: actions, transitions, goal test, costs. `src/lib/search/problem.ts:1` `mdml-engine/search`

- function `aStarSearch`: A* search; best-first and IDA* beside it. `src/lib/search/informed.ts:158` `mdml-engine/search`
- function `alphaBeta`: Minimax with alpha-beta pruning for two-player games. `src/lib/search/adversarial.ts:442` `mdml-engine/search`
- function `backtrackingSearch`: Backtracking search for constraint satisfaction problems. `src/lib/search/csp.ts:788` `mdml-engine/search`
- function `mcts`: Monte Carlo tree search for games. `src/lib/search/adversarial.ts:776` `mdml-engine/search`
- function `simulatedAnnealing`: Simulated annealing local search. `src/lib/search/local.ts:547` `mdml-engine/search`
- function `uniformCostSearch`: Uniform-cost search; BFS, DFS and iterative deepening beside it. `src/lib/search/uninformed.ts:481` `mdml-engine/search`

- algorithm `aStarSearchAlgorithm`: A* recording its frontier and explored set each step. `src/lib/search/informed.ts:135` `mdml-engine/search`

## search/evolutionary

Evolutionary computation: genetic algorithms, evolution strategies and genetic programming with their selection, crossover and mutation operators, quality-diversity search (MAP-Elites, novelty search) and neuroevolution (NEAT, with innovation numbers, speciation and structural mutation). Part of `mdml-engine/search`.

- function `geneticAlgorithm`: Genetic algorithm over chosen representations. `src/lib/search/evolutionary/genetic.ts:397` `mdml-engine/search`

## search/planning

Automated planning: finding a sequence of actions from an initial state to a goal. Here are STRIPS problems with forward and regression planners and their relaxation heuristics, GraphPlan, partial-order planning, hierarchical task networks and a PDDL reader. Part of `mdml-engine/search`.

- function `strips.ts` (file): STRIPS planning problems and planners. `src/lib/search/planning/strips.ts:1` `mdml-engine/search`
